definitions.explanation: The mathematical operation of subtracting one number from another.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}き{算|ざん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{苦手|にがて}→苦手：03513_nigate⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。

examples.english: To get the answer to a subtraction problem.

examples.japanese: ⟦{足|た}し{算|ざん}→足し算：05332_tashizan⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{引|ひ}き{算|ざん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{習|なら}う→習う：00479_narau⟧。

notes:
{引|ひ}き{算|ざん} means subtraction - one of the four basic arithmetic operations.

FORMS:
⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧ (to pull, subtract) + ⟦{算|さん}→算：noentry⟧ (calculation) = subtraction

THE FOUR BASIC OPERATIONS (⟦{四則|しそく}→四則：28865_shisoku⟧⟦{演算|えんざん}→演算：05150_enzan⟧):
- ⟦{足|た}し{算|ざん}→足し算：05332_tashizan⟧: addition (+)
- {引|ひ}き{算|ざん}: subtraction (-)
- ⟦{掛|か}け{算|ざん}→掛け算：05334_kakezan⟧: multiplication (×)
- ⟦{割|わ}り{算|ざん}→割り算：05335_warizan⟧: division (÷)

EXPRESSING SUBTRACTION:
- 10⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧3⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧7: 10 minus 3 is 7
- 10⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧3⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧: subtract 3 from 10

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {引|ひ}き{算|ざん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to do subtraction
- {引|ひ}き{算|ざん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧: subtraction problem
- {引|ひ}き{算|ざん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{得意|とくい}→得意：03455_tokui⟧/⟦{苦手|にがて}→苦手：03513_nigate⟧: to be good/bad at subtraction

RELATED MATH TERMS:
- ⟦{暗算|あんざん}→暗算：15852_anzan⟧: mental arithmetic
- ⟦{計算|けいさん}→計算：02697_keisan⟧: calculation
- ⟦{答|こた}え→答え：00790_kotae⟧: answer
- ⟦{差|さ}→差：02771_sa⟧: difference (result of subtraction)
